project_title: Gestione Pratiche e Note Open Fiber - GC Impianti SNC
context: Telecommunications field operations & office administration utility for Open Fiber practices managed by GC Impianti SNC. Built for instant PDF parsing, automated note composition, photo attachment per WR, one-click copy, direct Gmail dispatch with fixed recipients, and historical practice storage.
creator_credit: creato e amministrato da Giuseppe Belviso

gc_impianti.style: h-9 sm:h-11 w-auto object-contain rounded border border-slate-200 shadow-sm

note_template.parsing_rule: Parse single or multi-practice PDFs. Generate notes only for numeric WR codes. If WR contains letters, skip note generation per specification.

theme.mode: light with high-contrast slate borders (with dark header option / theme toggle support)

responsive.layout: Mobile: stacked 1-column layout with full-width cards and touch-friendly controls. Tablet/Desktop: grid-cols-12 with persistent filters and side-by-side parsed note cards.
responsive.typography: Mobile-optimized text sizes preventing horizontal scroll and automatic input zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Use overflow-x-hidden on container and flex-wrap / break-words on code blocks.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44px height for interactive buttons, file uploader, and action triggers.

key_components.name: Header & Administration Bar
key_components.description: Displays GC Impianti SNC and Open Fiber logos, app title 'Gestione Pratiche & Note Open Fiber', subtitle 'creato e amministrato da Giuseppe Belviso', quick stats badges, and primary tab controls.

key_components.name: PDF Pratica Upload Zone
key_components.description: Drag-and-drop PDF dropzone supporting multi-practice or single-practice PDF files. Shows parsing progress, practice count, and status alerts.

key_components.name: WR Note Card Editor
key_components.description: Card for each numeric WR practice containing editable formatted note block, custom field inputs (Address, OLO, CPE, ONT/SFP serials), 'Copia nota' button, 'Invia tramite Gmail' mailto trigger, and multi-photo attachment section.

key_components.name: Photo Attachment Manager
key_components.description: Multi-image file dropzone per WR card with grid thumbnail preview, image zoom/lightbox, and database persistence status.

key_components.name: Gmail Dispatch Trigger
key_components.description: Formulates mailto link containing pre-filled recipients (g.c.impiantiufficio@gmail.com, g.c.impiantisnc4@gmail.com, giuseppe.abbatiscianni@circet.it, dario.naviglio@circet.it, vito.lalario@circet.it), subject 'Pratica Open Fiber - WR: [WR_CODE]', and body containing formatted note text. Displays clear instruction popup to attach photos/PDF in Gmail if needed.

key_components.name: Storico Pratiche (Archive Table / Grid)
key_components.description: Searchable archive of saved practices with filter by WR, date, client, or OLO. Provides edit mode, quick re-copy, re-send email, and photo download/viewing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='upload-pdf-input', data-testid='copy-note-button', data-testid='send-gmail-button', data-testid='search-archive-input').
Implement full functionality for client-side and backend parsing of Open Fiber PDFs, extracting numeric WRs, addresses, OLOs, and customer data.
Ensure numeric WR filtering logic: if a WR code contains letters (e.g., 'WR1234A'), skip note creation as specified.
Preset exact email recipients: g.c.impiantiufficio@gmail.com, g.c.impiantisnc4@gmail.com, giuseppe.abbatiscianni@circet.it, dario.naviglio@circet.it, vito.lalario@circet.it in mailto href string.
Include toast notifications using Sonner when 'Copia nota' is clicked ('Nota copiata negli appunti!').
Persist practices and uploaded photos in the SQLite database and allow modification in the Storico section.
Maintain high accessibility contrast, clean card elevation, crisp monospace code editors for notes, and smooth micro-animations.
